name: l0_illusionary_spawn
about: `CFuncIllusionary::Spawn` 0x100bf760 (`walks/L0-r013.md`) over three `func_illusionary`s created at runtime (a map row's Spawn runs the same body at Load, before the trace sink; sp_tutorial_1's seventeen are unnamed). Arms in retail order: `SetAngles(&DAT_1070d9d0)` 0x100b2d00 with the static (0,0,0) -- written, with the EFL invalidation and `+0x1b1`, only when the stored angles differ (`ill_b` is authored at yaw -90 and ends at 0,0,0; `ill_a` at 0,0,0 writes nothing); `SetMoveType(0, 0)` 0x100aad70 (MOVETYPE_NONE, movecollide 0); `SetSolid(&m_Collision, 0)` 0x100dc480 (SOLID_NONE); `CBaseEntity::SetModel` 0x100ad460 over `GetModelName()` or "" -- `VEngineServer014` slots 20/21 type a model by its name and a type other than brush (1) only `Msg`s "Setting CBaseEntity to non-brush model %s"; `FUN_101cf4a0` re-sets index, name and collision bounds from a non-empty name and does nothing for an empty one; `+0x1b1` (`m_NetworkChangeState.m_bChanged`) is set unconditionally; then `FUN_101466e0(this + 0x1b0, 1)`, the `m_NetworkChangeState` byte 0. The body and visual of a map's illusionary are the world's (`EElysiumBrushSolidity::None`, the brush mesh, the hulls' bounds), what these words stand for. Reported as `fail`, a stored word or a site payload differs from retail's.
